user.title: Tellerflamme
user.description: Creates the pantry, a shopping list and sensors for the Tellerflamme app. Then enter the address and an access token in the app under “Ziele” → “Home Assistant”.

vorrat_setzen.name: Set pantry item
vorrat_setzen.description: Sets a pantry item to da (available), wenig (running low) or leer (empty). Creates it if missing.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name of the Home Assistant person (default: whoever runs the action, otherwise the main person)

vorrat_entfernen.name: Remove pantry item
vorrat_entfernen.description: Removes an item from the pantry.

init.title: People
init.description:
Every person in Home Assistant has their own Tellerflamme data and pantry, identified by the access token used in the app.

Choose who owns the data that existed before the split. This person also keeps the previous entity IDs (e.g. todo.tellerflamme_vorrat). Best changed before other devices reconnect.
